Apply a theme to a chart

Source: R/theme.R
hc_add_theme.Rd

Apply a theme to a chart

Usage

hc_add_theme(hc, hc_thm)

Arguments

hc

A highchart widget.

hc_thm

A theme built with hc_theme().

Value

The widget with the selected theme.

Examples

highchart() |>
  hc_add_series(data = c(7, 5, 9)) |>
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme("ft"))
